chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him)
The condition of the world at the time of the revelation of prophethood, its transience and the state of its inhabitants

key_terms.أَهْلِهَا: its inhabitants, people of the world
key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: the world, the lower realm of existence
key_terms.فَنَاءُهَا: its transience, perishability, or passing away

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about the state of the world at the time of prophethood?
ai.summary: This passage introduces the famous 'Sermon of the Transience of the World' (Khutbat al-Hudhud), where Imam Ali (AS) vividly describes the moral decay and spiritual blindness of the Jahiliyyah era prior to the advent of Islam. It underscores the Shia theological view that the Prophet’s mission was not merely to establish political order but to rectify the innate human condition and restore divine guidance to a world lost in ignorance.
